# MultiGammaEosConfig

`jaff.physics.thermodynamics.eos.config.MultiGammaEosConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Ideal gas with a per-species adiabatic index (`type = "multi_gamma"`).

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default_gamma` | `float` | Adiabatic index of species absent from `gamma_map`, > 1. |
| `gamma_map` | `dict[str, float]` | Adiabatic index per species name, each > 1. |
